LESSON: WRITING 6.5.1 COMMONLY MISSPELT WORDS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.5: Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we improve our spelling?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. recognise commonly misspelt words in texts
2. use commonly misspelt words correctly in written texts
3. value the relationship between accurate spelling and effective written communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words

Teach
• Focus skill: recognise commonly misspelt words in texts.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we improve our spelling?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
